description:
Record money received against threads, and produce billed-vs-received statements. Records are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/payments.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--as-of DATE] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change one field of a payment
  rm ID -y — delete a payment

Flags:
  log:
    THREAD             thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
    AMOUNT             required; positive decimal
    -c, --currency CODE  ISO code (default: the thread's)
    -d, --date DATE    date received, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
    -t, --time HH:MM   default now
    -a, --account NAME which account it landed in
    -n, --note TEXT    free text; takes several words, so put it last
  list:
    THREAD  only this thread
    --since DATE, --until DATE, --json
  statement:
    --thread THREAD  only this thread
    --since DATE, --until DATE  inclusive bounds
    --as-of DATE     statement date; drives aging (default today)
    --pdf PATH       render a PDF to PATH; requires --thread
    --json
  edit:
    --amount AMOUNT, -c CODE, -d DATE, -t HH:MM, -a ACCOUNT, -n TEXT (put -n last)
  rm:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Args:
  ID  8-char payment id from payments list

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "12500.00", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-10-15", "-n", "Invoice 42"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--pdf", "northwind-statement.pdf"]
  ["list", "Projects/Northwind"]

Notes:
  Put AMOUNT straight after THREAD, before any flags. -n consumes the words that follow it.
  log also adds a REF: to buffer.md, filed under the date received, which goes into the daily log on buffer flush.
  --pdf needs pandoc and xelatex.
  rm is permanent and fails without -y.
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: amount missing, invalid or not positive; --pdf without --thread; nothing to state for that thread and date.
